about: The introitus of the formulary “All Saints” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Let us all rejoice in the Lord, keeping a festal day to honor all the saints, over whose solemn feast the angels rejoice and together laud the Son of God. Exult in the Lord, you just; praise befits the upright. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. Let us all rejoice in the Lord, keeping a festal day to honor all the saints, over whose solemn feast the angels rejoice and together laud the Son of God.
